note: Companion explainers — how to perform each stage, spoken, one clip per stage. ASSEMBLY: spoken from practice/CURRICULUM_CARDS.md (which cites its attested anchors). Same voice as guide + meditations. Play before the sitting.
voice: slow guide (community Osho-style — direction label only, never worn as identity)

stages.title: Full body round
stages.say: Stage one, the full body round. Sit upright, breathe naturally, never forcing the breath. For each of the fifty sounds: chant it aloud, touch its place, look at the glyph — three things at once. The mind stays on the sound arriving at its place. Do not visualize yet: the image comes only after this association is stable. No forced breath ratios. One sound complete before the next.

stages.title: Vowel powers
stages.say: Stage two, vowel powers. Same frame. Now each vowel carries its power: a is consciousness, aa is bliss, i is will. Chant at the locus while holding the power as meaning with the sound. Where a recording is silent — the rare vowels — touch and breathe, never substitute. The power is held as what it means, not imagined as color.

stages.title: Varga isolation
stages.say: Stage three, varga isolation. One limb, five slow rounds, chanting along the arc as you touch it. The mind makes the five points into one continuous line — shoulder to fingers as a single shape. Slower than the full round: coverage is not the aim, the arc is. No visualization yet.

stages.title: Recall, both directions
stages.say: Stage four, recall both directions. No chart on screen. When the sound plays, let the point arrive in you before you answer. When a point is named, let the sound name itself. You are training knowing-before-looking. About twenty answers, then stop. This is where the map stops being external.

stages.title: Reverse pass
stages.say: Stage five, the reverse round. From kṣa back toward a, slower than the install. The mind subtracts: the field thins as you go, each sound leaving rather than filling. Touch optional. Do not skip the rare sounds to make it smooth. The emptying is the practice, not an effect after it.

stages.title: Aṅga five points
stages.say: Stage six, the rapid install. Five points: heart, head, shoulders, eyes, hands. The formula voiced aloud at each place, three rounds. The mind makes one gesture of the five — whole body, one sweep. Speed comes from clarity, not haste. If a formula is unsure, slow that round. Correct first, the sixty-second bar second.

stages.title: Mantra trajectory
stages.say: Stage seven, mantra trajectories. Attention rides the mantra's route: each syllable landing on its place, the light following the sound. Sound first — the light is confirmation, not the object. Chant along if the voice is ready, listen if it is not. One trajectory, looped with a breathing gap. One mantra per sitting.

stages.title: Ascent and nectar
stages.say: Stage eight, ascent and nectar. Station by station from the heart upward, one breath held at each, up to the crown. Then let the nectar rain back down without guiding it. The mind rides up, then releases the riding. The descent is not a second task — it is what happens when you stop climbing.

stages.title: Mālinī order
stages.say: Stage nine, Mālinī order — only once Mātṛkā is automatic. The same fifty sounds in her sequence, from na to pha, at her own loci. The mind actively unlearns the first map: when a sound lands somewhere new, let it. Do not correct it back. The strangeness is the content. Never relabel the first map's points as Mālinī.

stages.title: Gaze inward
stages.say: Stage ten, gaze inward. Rest the vision on one point, the body wide around it, breath untouched. Let the outer sound turn inward — the mouth may soften or stop while the sound continues inside. Wander, and return to the point, not to effort. Not a stillness score: the gate is that the inner ascent is available on demand.
